The scientists may have gone too far in creating some sort of hybrid dinosaur, which escapes and terrorises the park.

sky cinema action.title: Hummingbird
sky cinema action.desc: An alcoholic ex-soldier struggles to atone for his sins.

sky cinema action.title: Bad Boys II
sky cinema action.desc: Loose-cannon cops Lowrey and Burnett reduce Miami to rubble as they try to stop Cuban and Russian drug smugglers from flooding Florida with ecstasy.

sky cinema action.title: Bad Boys for Life
sky cinema action.desc: Old-school cops Mike Lowery and Marcus Burnett team up to take down the vicious leader of a Miami drug cartel. Newly created elite team AMMO of the Miami police department along with Mike and Marcus go up against the ruthless Armando Armas.

sky cinema action.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
sky cinema action.desc: Greek Gen. Themistocles leads the charge to fight invading Persian forces led by the god Xerxes -- once a mortal -- and Artemisia.

sky cinema family.title: Jack the Giant Slayer
sky cinema family.desc: A young farmhand gets swept into the realm of legend when he must defend his land from a seemingly unstoppable force of giant warriors.

sky cinema family.title: Cats & Dogs
sky cinema family.desc: Unknown to humans, all-out war between cats and dogs has raged since the beginning of time. Now the cats face defeat if scientist Professor Brody can perfect a formula that will make all humans non-allergic to dogs. The cats' leader, Mr Tinkles, plans to steal the serum, but first he must get past fearless dog agent Lou who, thanks to a mistake in recruitment, guards the Brody family.

sky cinema family.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
sky cinema family.desc: The canine and feline species join forces to thwart the evil plans of Kitty Galore who dreams of global domination.

sky cinema family.title: A Minecraft Movie
sky cinema family.desc: A mysterious portal pulls four misfits into the Overworld, a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master the terrain while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected crafter named Steve.

sky cinema family.title: Johnny English
sky cinema family.desc: Spoof spy caper with the eponymous, blundering hero attempting to recover the crown jewels and save Britain from an evil mastermind when all the other agents are killed. Promoted from lowly pen pusher to super spy, Johnny English is baffled when clues lead to respected entrepreneur Pascal Sauvage, but could the enigmatic Lorna hold the key to the mystery?

sky cinema comedy.title: Hot Fuzz
sky cinema comedy.desc: Hot-shot police officer Nicholas Angel smells foul play when the residents of a sleepy Somerset village start to die in terrible `accidents'. Something's afoot, but can he - and daft local plod Danny Butterman - find out what?

sky cinema comedy.title: We're the Millers
sky cinema comedy.desc: Indebted to a big-time drug lord, a pot dealer travels to Mexico with a fake family and a camper to pick up a large shipment and smuggle it into the U.S.

sky cinema comedy.title: Mother's Pride
sky cinema comedy.desc: About a failing pub, a divided community, and a grieving family whose lives are changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards.

sky cinema comedy.title: American Pie: Reunion
sky cinema comedy.desc: Outrageous antics ensue when Jim, Michelle, Stifler and the gang get back together for their 13-year high school reunion.

sky cinema comedy.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
sky cinema comedy.desc: After jumping back into the dating pool, single mother Bridget Jones finds herself caught between a younger man and her son's science teacher.

sky cinema comedy.title: Notting Hill
sky cinema comedy.desc: Anna Scott is the most famous actress in the world, and William Thacker a second hand bookshop owner in Notting Hill. After colliding in the street they begin a relationship which is soon fraught with complications as the tabloid press hound Anna. William must then summon all his charm, ingenuity and patience if there is to be a happy ending.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: The Autobots and the Decepticons become involved in a space race to find a hidden Cybertronian spacecraft stranded on the Moon. Sam Witwicky must come to the aid of the Autobots to defeat the evil Decepticons to stop them discovering the secrets of the Cybertronian craft.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: As humanity picks up the pieces after an epic battle, a shadowy group emerges to gain control of history. Meanwhile, a powerful new menace sets its sights on Earth.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Transformers: The Last Knight
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: As war with the Transformers rages on, inventor Cade Yeager forms an unlikely alliance with Bumblebee, an English lord and an Oxford professor to save the planet.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Transformers
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Geeky highschooler Sam Witwicky buys his first-ever car, hoping it will improve his chances with Mikaela. Imagine his surprise when his beat-down Camaro transforms into an alien robot called `Bumblebee' and asks for his assistance in a deadly war.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Mikaela and Sam once again join forces with Optimus Prime again to save Earth from ruthless robot The Fallen.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: The Autobots and the Decepticons become involved in a space race to find a hidden Cybertronian spacecraft stranded on the Moon. Sam Witwicky must come to the aid of the Autobots to defeat the evil Decepticons to stop them discovering the secrets of the Cybertronian craft.

sky cinema thriller.title: Civil War
sky cinema thriller.desc: In a dystopian future America, a team of military-embedded journalists races against time to reach Washington, D.C., before rebel factions descend upon the White House.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Bank Job
sky cinema thriller.desc: London, 1971: Terry Leather's ex-girlfriend Martine turns up with a tempting proposition. A bank's alarm is scheduled to be turned off for a week, so Terry and his team tunnel through to the vault from a neighbouring property.

sky cinema thriller.title: Mr & Mrs Smith
sky cinema thriller.desc: John and Jane Smith are a typical suburban couple first seen undergoing marriage counselling to try and get the spark back in their relationship. What neither of them knows is that the other is a highly skilled assassin until, separately, they get a call for their next job. Accidentally double-booked, they discover the truth about each other's secret existence, and are in danger not just from their bosses, but each other.

sky cinema thriller.title: Black Bag
sky cinema thriller.desc: When his beloved wife, Kathryn, is suspected of betraying the nation, intelligence agent George Woodhouse faces the ultimate test -- loyalty to his marriage or his country.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Girl on the Train
sky cinema thriller.desc: A divorced train commuter passes the house she used to live in with her husband every day. To distract herself she creates a fictional perfect world for her former neighbours in her head. This is ruined when one of the neighbours goes missing.

sky cinema greats.title: Logan's Run
sky cinema greats.desc: In 2274, computers rule a hermetically sealed city housing the survivors of a holocaust that has decimated the earth. Life is hedonistic and happy for the city's inhabitants; unfortunately they must be terminated when they reach 30. When Logan 5, a trained hunter for the system, grows intrigued by a beautiful young woman, he is forced to question the fundamental principles of his society and decides he must flee.

sky cinema greats.title: Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves
sky cinema greats.desc: On his return from the Crusades, Robin of Locksley learns that his father has been murdered by the tyrannical Sheriff of Nottingham and embarks on a campaign of guerrilla warfare to protect King Richard's throne. Fight scenes are lively and inventive, and a set piece fought under the forest canopy pulls out all the stops.

sky cinema greats.title: Lake Placid
sky cinema greats.desc: Following the death of a local diver, a New York palaeontologist is sent out to help the local fisheries warden investigate the case.

sky cinema greats.title: Anaconda
sky cinema greats.desc: The film crew for a nature documentary on a legendary tribe of the area is hijacked by Sarone, a madman intent on capturing the biggest snake in the Amazon, but since reptiles don't grow to 40 feet without eating, who's hunting whom?

sky cinema greats.title: Jaws
sky cinema greats.desc: Scary chiller about a coastal community plagued by a killer shark. With the summer tourist season at hand, the mayor is keen to keep the first attack hushed up. However, when an expert claims that the attacks are the work of a giant great white shark, there is only one solution - to kill the monster fish before it can feed again.

sky cinema drama.title: Don't Let's Go to the Dogs Tonight
sky cinema drama.desc: Depicts 8-year-old Bobo's life on her family's Rhodesian farm during the Bush War's final stages. It explores the family's bond with Africa's land and the war's impact on the region and individuals through Bobo's perspective.

sky cinema drama.title: Tow
sky cinema drama.desc: The true story of Amanda Ogle, a homeless Seattle woman who fought her way out of tow-company hell to reclaim her life and car after receiving a tow bill for $21,634.

sky cinema drama.title: Widow Clicquot
sky cinema drama.desc: The story behind the Veuve Clicquot champagne family and business that began in the late 18th century.

sky cinema drama.title: Flashdance
sky cinema drama.desc: A young female welder dreams of becoming a professional dancer and struggles against all the odds to realise her dream. However, in her effort to succeed, she discovers that getting to the top is far from easy. Giorgio Moroder's composition `Flashdance (What a Feeling)', sung by Irene Cara, won an Academy Award for Best Original Song.

sky cinema drama.title: Valentine's Day
sky cinema drama.desc: Following a group of Los Angeles' residents who try to find their way through the highs and lows of love during a single day.
